messages.subject: How are NA values handled?
parts:
How are NA values handled... or not?

ex: 
df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(10), y = c(rnorm(8), NA, NA))
ggvis(df, ~x, ~y) # There are 10 points when there should only be 8!

Cory
